faq_heading: Surrey coach houses: your questions answered

faq.q: How big can a coach house be in Surrey?
faq.a: Between 35 and 75 square metres. On lots zoned RA, R2, R2-O or R3 it can reach 120 square metres where the existing house or duplex is below its maximum floor area ratio.

faq.q: Can a Surrey coach house have a secondary suite in it?
faq.a: No. Surrey does not allow a secondary suite inside a coach house or garden suite. A suite is allowed in the main house, one per unit, up to 40% of the principal unit’s habitable floor area.

faq.q: Does a Surrey lot need a lane for a coach house?
faq.a: On smaller R3 to R6 lots, yes: the rules require lane access for a coach house. The lot also needs one extra parking space.

faq.q: How much does a Surrey house with a coach house cost?
faq.a: About 43% above the all-house median. 10 Surrey and North Surrey houses marked as a coach or laneway house sold from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026 at a median of $1,853,000, against $1,300,000 for all Surrey and North Surrey detached houses. The flag is entered by the listing agent, so the true number is higher. With only 10 sales the gap is a rough sign, not a trend. Across all of Surrey the median was $1,385,000 in the year to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Is a coach house the same as a garden suite in Surrey?
faq.a: Surrey’s rule covers both in one sentence: a coach house or garden suite is 35 to 75 square metres, allowed in any zone that allows detached houses, duplexes or houseplexes.

faq.q: Do these rules apply in White Rock, Langley or Delta?
faq.a: No. They are Surrey’s. White Rock, the Township of Langley, the City of Langley and Delta each have their own bylaws, so confirm the city before you read a listing.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Coach house figures come from the Carriage/Coach House and Laneway House style flags in Paragon closed and pending sales, which the listing agent fills in, so the counts are small and will miss some. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists detached houses for sale in Surrey and North Surrey that come with a coach house: a second, smaller home on the same lot, usually built over a garage at the back. It runs from Fleetwood and Newton across to Guildford and Fraser Heights. Cloverdale and South Surrey have their own coach house searches, linked at the bottom.

Paragon marks 10 of the 946 Surrey and North Surrey detached houses that sold from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026 as a coach house or laneway house. They sold at a median of $1,853,000, 43% above the $1,300,000 median for all Surrey and North Surrey houses in the same months. The flag is typed in by the listing agent, so treat the count as a floor and not a census. With only 10 sales the price gap is a rough sign, not a trend. Across the whole City of Surrey the median detached house price was $1,385,000 in the year to October 22, 2026.
What Surrey allows for a coach house

Surrey puts coach houses and garden suites under one rule. Each has to be at least 35 and at most 75 square metres, and any residential zone that allows detached houses, duplexes or houseplexes also allows one.

The cap rises to 120 square metres on lots zoned RA, R2, R2-O or R3, but only where the existing house or duplex is below its maximum floor area ratio. A coach house on a smaller R3 to R6 lot needs lane access, and the lot must have one extra parking space.

A secondary suite cannot go inside a coach house or garden suite. Surrey allows one suite per single-family, semi-detached or duplex unit, at most 40% of the main unit’s habitable floor area, and a suite cannot be sold as its own strata lot.

On July 8, 2024 Surrey folded 20 single-family and duplex zones into nine small-scale zones, and the old codes such as RF-12C and RF-13 went with them. A listing or a seller who quotes an old zone name is working from an out-of-date map.
When a lot could hold more than a coach house

The same July 2024 changes let a lot take 3 units when it is under 280 square metres and 4 when it is larger, and up to 6 on an eligible lot of at least 281 square metres within 400 metres of a frequent bus stop. They reach more than 72,000 lots under 4,050 square metres inside the urban containment boundary. A buyer who wants a houseplex rather than a single coach house should price both routes before choosing the lot.
Surrey and North Surrey neighbourhoods: lot size comes first

A coach house needs room behind or beside the main house, and on smaller lots a lane, so I read the lot size before the price. Among neighbourhoods with 20 or more house sales, Sullivan Station has the smallest median lot at 3,815 sq ft and Whalley the largest at 7,852 sq ft. Fraser Heights is the dearest at a $1,559,000 median and Bridgeview the cheapest at $1,040,000.

About one-third of Surrey is designated Agriculture in the Official Community Plan, and 95% of that land is inside the Agricultural Land Reserve. The small-scale rules above are for urban lots, not a route to extra homes on Reserve land. Bridgeview sits behind dikes. Confirm Reserve and floodplain status before you count on a second home.

Costs that come with a second home

Surrey’s 2026 residential property tax rate is $3.42731 per $1,000 of assessed value. A legal secondary suite in the main house adds $454.00 for water and $821.71 for sewer in 2026, $1,275.71 in all, plus $172.04 for garbage. Flat-rate utilities for a house without a suite are $1,195 for water and $1,661 for sewer, and $344.08 for waste.
Before you make an offer on a house with a coach house

items.t: Ask for the building permit and the final inspection for the coach house itself, not just for the garage under it.
Measure it against the 35 to 75 square metre range, or the 120 square metre range if the lot is RA, R2, R2-O or R3.
Check where the second home is reached from. A coach house on a smaller R3 to R6 lot is a lane-access building.
Count the parking. The rule asks for one extra space for the coach house.
Ask the City whether any suite in the main house is registered. Surrey says its 2024 changes do not make an unpermitted suite legal after the fact.
